Frequently Asked Questions
ULTRA Family 128
ULTRA Postpaid 45, 68, ULTRA Global 98
What is ULTRA Family 128?
ULTRA Family 128 is a family mobile plan that allows multiple lines to share a single plan with high-speed data, unlimited calls, and value-added benefits.
Who can sign up for ULTRA Family 128?
Anyone eligible for a mobile subscription can sign up as the primary account holder and add family members under the same plan.
I am an existing customer with a device contract. Can I subscribe to ULTRA Family 128?
Yes, existing customers can subscribe, but it depends on your current contract terms. You may need to complete your contract, pay an early termination fee, or switch within eligible plans.
